parameters.subject: =Thanks for your interest in the {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.vehicle_interest }}
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.name }},

Thanks for getting in touch with NEXUS OS about the {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.vehicle_interest }}.

I've made a note of what you're looking for. If you'd like, I can put together a few options in your budget and arrange a time for you to come see them.

Just reply to this email and let me know what suits you.

Best regards,
NEXUS OS Sales Team

parameters.subject: =Still looking at the {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.vehicle_interest }}?
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.name }},

Just checking in on the {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.vehicle_interest }} you were interested in.

We've had some new arrivals this week, so if your requirements have changed at all, let me know and I'll send over what fits.

Happy to answer any questions - finance, trade-in value, warranty, anything.

Best regards,
NEXUS OS Sales Team

parameters.subject: =A 5% offer on your {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.vehicle_interest }} - valid 48 hours
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.name }},

I wanted to come back to you one last time about the {{ $('Normalize Lead Input').first().json.vehicle_interest }}.

As a thank you for your interest, we can offer you an exclusive 5% discount on your first purchase with us. This one is valid for the next 48 hours.

If the timing isn't right, that's completely fine - just reply and tell me, and I'll stop following up.

Best regards,
NEXUS OS Sales Team
